patches.find: De no ser por ese señor, el lunes no habríamos tenido vacunas para la jornada de las escuelas.
patches.replace: De no ser por ese señor, nos habríamos quedado sin vacunas para la jornada de las escuelas de mañana.
patches.why: Nidia speaks on Sunday about Monday: 'el lunes no habríamos tenido' puts a not-yet-happened event in a past counterfactual; now a past counterfactual with a present-relevant result (keeps de no ser por + conditional perfect).

patches.find: If it weren’t for that man, we wouldn’t have had vaccines for the school vaccination day on Monday.
patches.replace: If it hadn’t been for that man, we’d have been left without vaccines for tomorrow’s school vaccination day.
patches.why: EN follows ES fix.

patches.find: De no ser por ese señor, el lunes no habríamos tenido vacunas;
patches.replace: De no ser por ese señor, nos habríamos quedado sin vacunas;
patches.why: concepts quote follows the text.

patches.find: De no ser por ese señor, el lunes no habríamos tenido vacunas para la jornada de las escuelas
patches.replace: De no ser por ese señor, nos habríamos quedado sin vacunas para la jornada de las escuelas de mañana
patches.why: Card example kept verbatim with the patched text.

patches.find: If it weren’t for that man, we wouldn’t have had vaccines for the school vaccination day on Monday

patches.find: ante el aviso de tormenta, las neveras fueron trasladadas
patches.replace: ante la tormenta que se avecinaba, las neveras fueron trasladadas
patches.why: Plot precision: Lionel sent the boxes before the 13:30 warning (refuel 13:20; role-play says 'antes del aviso'); a report praised for precision should not say 'ante el aviso'.

patches.find: in view of the storm warning, the cold boxes
patches.replace: in view of the approaching storm, the cold boxes
patches.why: EN follows ES fix.

patches.find: Las sospechas cayeron enseguida sobre Ayoze, lo cual era previsible
patches.replace: Entre los de fuera, las sospechas cayeron enseguida sobre Ayoze, lo cual era previsible
patches.why: Plot hole: the whole village understood the whistle (Yurena's name + 'devuélvelo'), so 'everyone' suspecting Ayoze contradicts the story; suspicion is now the outsiders'.

patches.find: Suspicion fell on Ayoze at once, which was predictable
patches.replace: Among us outsiders, suspicion fell on Ayoze at once, which was predictable
patches.why: EN follows ES fix.

patches.find: ¿Por qué sospecha todo el mundo, al principio, de Ayoze?
patches.replace: ¿Por qué sospechan de Ayoze, al principio, los de fuera?
patches.why: Quiz stem follows the plot fix.

patches.find: de la cual solo ella tenía copia.
patches.replace: de la cual solo ella tenía llave.
patches.why: 'tener copia' of a classroom is unidiomatic (copia de la llave); 'tener llave de' is the natural collocation.

patches.find: de la cual solo ella tenía copia;
patches.replace: de la cual solo ella tenía llave;
patches.why: concepts quote follows the text.

patches.find: en una Barlovento cuyas
patches.replace: en un Barlovento cuyas
patches.why: Agreement: the region name Barlovento is masculine ('un Barlovento').

patches.find: En el patio de la casa colgaba de un clavo la olla grande
patches.replace: En casa del tío, recordó, colgaba de un clavo la olla grande
patches.why: Plot hole: if she saw his yard on the 19th she would have seen the missing sacks that are in the same yard in line 7; now she remembers the pot.

patches.find: In the yard of his house, the big pot
patches.replace: At her uncle's house, she remembered, the big pot
patches.why: EN follows ES fix.

patches.find: A las cinco de la mañana del 22 caminaron
patches.replace: A las cinco de la mañana del 20 caminaron
patches.why: Timeline: the cut test is 'esa noche' and she says 'Ahora madrugamos', so the dawn visit is the next day (20th), not three days later; also leaves a plausible time to roast before the 23rd.

patches.find: At five in the morning on the 22nd
patches.replace: At five in the morning on the 20th
patches.why: EN follows ES fix.

patches.find: don't mix them up: *¿quién se habría llevado…? sounds hypothetical rather than like a guess about a fact.
patches.replace: don't mix them up: ¿quién se habría llevado…? is not wrong, but it places the guess further back (before another past moment) or sounds hypothetical.
patches.why: Wrong claim: '¿quién se habría llevado…?' (conditional of conjecture) is grammatical, so it must not be starred.

patches.find: the common error is translating 'going around saying' with *van diciendo, which means 'saying things one after another along the way'.
patches.replace: a common slip is to use ir + gerund (van diciendo), which stresses gradual progress ('saying things one after another') rather than the disapproving 'here and there' of andar.
patches.why: Misleading star: 'van diciendo (por ahí)' is grammatical; the contrast is one of meaning.

patches.find: Van diciendo que el muchacho vendió los sacos.
patches.replace: Acaban de decir que el muchacho vendió los sacos.
patches.why: Ambiguity: 'van diciendo (por ahí)' can also mean spreading a rumour around; replaced with a clearly different distractor.

patches.find: y las sacaban de las mismas tallas que en los esteros vecinos, donde no pasaba nada
patches.replace: y trabajaban allí los mismos días que en los esteros vecinos, donde no pasaba nada
patches.why: Logic: Guarapo sizes are below 4.4 cm (line 0, report), so 'they took them at the same sizes as elsewhere' contradicts the data; the catch sheet now shows effort did not increase.

patches.find: and they were taking them at the same sizes as in the neighbouring estuaries
patches.replace: and they worked there the same number of days as in the neighbouring estuaries
patches.why: EN follows ES fix.

patches.find: y de las mismas tallas que en otros esteros
patches.replace: y trabajaban allí los mismos días que en otros esteros
patches.why: Quiz option follows the text fix.

patches.find: Nadie las estaba sacando chiquitas: simplemente tardaban más en llegar a la talla.
patches.replace: Nadie estaba esquilmando el estero: las conchas simplemente tardaban más en llegar a la talla.
patches.why: Logic: the measured cockles ARE small; the point is that they were not overharvested.

patches.find: Nobody was taking them small: they were simply taking longer to reach legal size.
patches.replace: Nobody was stripping the estuary: the cockles were simply taking longer to reach legal size.
patches.why: EN follows ES fix.

patches.find: Yo estuve de conchera desde los doce años
patches.replace: Yo estoy de conchera desde los doce años
patches.why: Grammar: preterite 'estuve' + 'desde' for a still-ongoing activity is ungrammatical (writer flagged it); present + desde is the norm.

patches.find: yo estuve de conchera;
patches.replace: yo estoy de conchera;
patches.why: concepts quote follows the text.

patches.find: Yo estuve de conchera desde los doce años
patches.replace: Yo estoy de conchera desde los doce años
patches.why: Card example verbatim with the patched text.

patches.find: often for a period: estuve de conchera.
patches.replace: often for a period: estoy de conchera desde los doce años.
patches.why: Card explain follows the fix.

patches.find: *estuve como conchera
patches.replace: *estoy como conchera
patches.why: Card explain follows the fix.

patches.find: Yo estuve de conchera desde los doce años
patches.replace: Yo estoy de conchera desde los doce años
patches.why: Same grammar fix in the role-play.

patches.find: se acercó al micrófono y se le quebró la voz
patches.replace: se acercó al micrófono para traducirlo y se le quebró la voz
patches.why: Clarity of the climax: the quoted line is Celestino's live translation of what Paulina says to the baby, not his own order to Dionisio.

patches.find: leaned towards the microphone and his voice broke
patches.replace: leaned towards the microphone to translate it and his voice broke
patches.why: EN follows ES fix.

patches.find: un título colectivo sobre su territorio ancestral
patches.replace: un título colectivo sobre una parte de su territorio ancestral
patches.why: Fact precision: Serie C 305 ordered a collective title over the area 'Lote A1' and demarcation of already titled lands, not title to the whole ancestral territory.

patches.find: grant the community collective title to its ancestral territory
patches.replace: grant the community collective title to part of its ancestral territory
patches.why: EN follows ES fix.

patches.find: as if they were old school friends
patches.replace: as if they were old friends
patches.why: EN adds 'school' not in the Spanish ('viejos amigos').

patches.find: Common error: *negó de haber pedido or *negó que había pedido for the same subject; say negó haber pedido.
patches.replace: Common error: *negó de haber pedido; with the same subject, the compact negó haber pedido is preferred to negó que hubiera pedido.
patches.why: Wrong claim: 'negó que + indicative/subjunctive' is grammatical; only the preposition is an error.

patches.find: Mirna negó que pidió censura alguna.
patches.replace: Mirna negó haber pidiendo censura alguna.
patches.why: Distractor 'negó que pidió' is defensible in real usage (two arguable answers); replaced with an unambiguous error.

c1-01.grade: A- : solid C1 (impersonal se vs pasiva refleja, de + compound infinitive, reporting verbs all well spread), good fuel-log clue; census figures verified (31.7% 2023 vs 9.2% 2010); two time-logic slips fixed
issues_fixed: 'De no ser por ese señor, el lunes no habríamos tenido vacunas' said on Sunday about Monday -> 'nos habríamos quedado sin vacunas para la jornada de las escuelas de mañana' (+EN, card example, concepts)
report says 'ante el aviso de tormenta' but Lionel acted before the 13:30 warning -> 'ante la tormenta que se avecinaba' (+EN)
issues_open: 'Nidia tardó veinte minutos en abrir la nevera de Urgencias' reads oddly (why 20 min?); left unchanged because of the 1,300-word cap (now 1,295)
Abrupt jump from Friday evening (line 3) to 'Aquel sábado' (line 4): owner may want a time marker
Panamanian lexicon and Guari-guari 'Wa'appin' / 'Miss Archbold' (writer's list); 'repostar' may be Spain-leaning for Panama (tanquear)
'tirar la toalla' is listed as a dialogue idiom but appears only in narration (card says idioms 'in dialogue')
Cold-box insulin waiting until Saturday 'se habría echado a perder' is plausible but stylised

c1-02.grade: A- : elegant first-person journalistic C1 (el cual after prepositions, pseudo-clefts, no porque…sino porque), silbo facts verified (UNESCO 2009, schools 1999); one plot hole fixed
issues_fixed: plot hole: the whole village understood the whistle, so 'Las sospechas cayeron [en todos] sobre Ayoze' contradicted the story -> 'Entre los de fuera, las sospechas…' (+EN, quiz Q1 stem)
'de la cual solo ella tenía copia' (copy of a classroom) -> 'tenía llave' (+concepts)
issues_open: EN 'Small town, big hell' is a literal gloss (also in the card); owner may prefer an idiomatic EN rendering
'lo cual explicaba que hasta los niños del pueblo se hubieran reído de mí': children laughing were never shown (only 'varios se rieron')
'Pueblo chico, infierno grande' is more Latin American than Canarian; native Gomeran check
Whether Nieves (jury president, local) understood the whistle is left implicit
Silbo decoding feasibility for a beginner overnight (silbador check)

c1-03.grade: A- : warm, well-plotted (guava-and-panela tasting note pays off twice), all four perfect-tense topics demonstrated 3+ times; timeline/location slips and two card over-claims fixed
issues_fixed: plot hole: on the 19th she sees the pot in Críspulo's yard, where the missing sacks are found later -> 'En casa del tío, recordó, colgaba…' (+EN)
timeline: 'Ahora madrugamos' after the cut test, but the dawn visit was 'del 22' -> 'del 20' (+EN)
card: '*¿quién se habría llevado…?' starred as an error although it is grammatical (conditional of conjecture)
card + gq: 'van diciendo' starred/used as a distractor although 'van diciendo (por ahí)' can mean spreading a rumour -> card reworded, distractor replaced with 'Acaban de decir…' (also in all-gq)
issues_open: Plausibility of 300 kg roasted on a budare for one night's chocolate (logline figure; owner decision)
'Échale bolas' is mildly vulgar in Venezuela (owner decision; alternative 'métele el pecho')
Order of drums at the 23 June velorio (mina/curbata vs culo e' puya) for a Curiepe speaker
'Cuando hayan pesado el último saco, me llaman' in the plaza is slightly unmotivated (which sacks?)
Role-play scene says 'eve of the festival' at night while the story's reveal is at dawn on the 20th; harmless

c1-04.grade: B+ : strong ecology plot and register play, but the data logic was self-contradictory and the model 'estuve de… desde' was ungrammatical (both fixed); good décima (octosyllables check)
issues_fixed: logic: catch sheet said women took cockles 'de las mismas tallas que en los esteros vecinos' although Guarapo sizes are 4.4 cm -> effort comparison 'trabajaban allí los mismos días' (+EN, quiz Q2 option)
logic: 'Nadie las estaba sacando chiquitas' contradicted the small sizes -> 'Nadie estaba esquilmando el estero: las conchas simplemente tardaban más…' (+EN)
'Yo estuve de conchera desde los doce años' (preterite + desde, ongoing) -> 'Yo estoy de conchera…' in story, card example/explain, concepts and role-play
issues_open: Esmeraldas voseo forms (sabés/querés/vengás vs vos sabes): native check; card says 'vos… with its own verb forms (vos sabés)'
'estar de conchera' for a lifelong occupation (vs 'soy conchera') still mildly marked: native check
Average-size drop 5.1 -> 4.4 cm in five months is stylised
Current legality of the 4.5 cm minimum: Acuerdos 149/005 found but current text not confirmed
Ermelinda using usted with a young biologist (writer's note)

c1-05.grade: A- : moving, tightly plotted (P. G. initials + 'bautizado con tambores' payoff), excellent usted/tú/vos dynamics; Court ruling verified (8 Oct 2015, Serie C 305) with one overstatement softened
issues_fixed: fact: the Court ordered a collective title over 'Lote A1', not the whole ancestral territory -> 'sobre una parte de su territorio ancestral' (+EN)
climax ambiguity: 'Callate, Dionisio…' read as Celestino's own order -> 'se acercó al micrófono para traducirlo' (+EN)
card claimed '*negó que había pedido' is an error; gq distractor 'negó que pidió' arguably acceptable (two defensible answers) -> card reworded, distractor replaced (also in all-gq)
issues_open: Garifuna items (buiti binafi, garaón) and Honduran lexicon: Garifuna speaker
Keyla mixes usted ('Ni lo piense') and vos ('vos sabés') in one turn: deliberate per narration, native check
Two sayings stacked in one line ('más vale solo…' + 'lo barato sale caro'): stylistic
'el radiomaratón' gender/term in Honduras
